modelBehaviorBoundaries: qwen3:4b does not always call the skill pseudo-tool on a plain risk-review phrasing; with an explicit instruction to load the skill it does (two consecutive runs activated and then completed a real risk review).

On plain detail queries the model sometimes summarised the request instead of calling getContractDetail; at least one verified run (and the final default-path run) did call the tool. Model decision quality limitations remain as KI-29 records.
No fixture, mock provider or scripted response was used for the model; business tools hit the real synthetic MySQL database.
fixesVerifiedHere: KI-47 (new): custom AgentCard bean suppressed starter A2aServerAgentCardAutoConfiguration so A2aServerAgentCardProperties bean was missing - every *OfficialA2aAgent would fail startup in a real distributed run; fixed by registering the properties in common-a2a LiveSkillAgentCardAutoConfiguration (idempotent EnableConfigurationProperties).
KI-46: managed activation log carries skill name, task sha256 + char count, callId, threadId; task text, body, and argument secrets verified absent (unit tests + this smoke).
Legacy SkillTool log also switched to fingerprint form (no raw task text).
residualBoundaries: A2A wire format: starter JsonRpcA2aRequestHandler returns -32700 for any Jackson binding failure; a params.configuration field with blocking=true from the standard A2A examples is rejected - clients must follow the SDK serialization (no configuration field). Recorded as a client-compat note, not fixed in this change.
The local 4B model is not a substitute for production DeepSeek cloud quality; task 5.5 real-model criterion is met by a real LLM, and production model quality claims are not made here.

smoke namespace bk-acceptance-smoke and synthetic database bk_contract_smoke_fe6bbaf091 are left in the local environment for re-inspection; the acceptance dataId content has been replaced with a tombstone comment.
